title: Trends in Sudden Cardiovascular Death in Young Competitive Athletes After Implementation of a Preparticipation Screening Program
claims: In the Veneto region of Italy, the annual incidence of sudden cardiovascular death in young competitive athletes decreased by 89% after implementation of a pre-participation screening program, from 3.6 to 0.4 per 100,000 person-years between 1979-1980 and 2003-2004.
The incidence of sudden death among the unscreened non-athlete population did not change significantly over the same period.
The Italian screening program included personal and family history, physical examination and 12-lead ECG.
